decisions.subject: artifact-slow-mo + dash interaction
decisions.decision: Option B — exempt dash window from speed cap
details: During active dash ability window (0.5s), artifact-slow-mo speed cap is bypassed
Cap re-applies the frame after dash expires
Shield and teleport remain subject to the cap as normal
Rationale: slow-mo is a passive runaway-prevention cap, not an ability suppressor. Dash with no effect reads as a bug, not a trade-off. 0.5s window is too short to undermine slow-mo purpose.
Implementation: in getEffectiveCatSpeedCap(state), return Infinity (or CAT_MAX_SPEED) when state.run.cat.activeAbility === 'dash'
